name: Mega Minds in Central Square 2023

venue.name: St Mary Orthodox Church
venue.details: Enter through the brown side doors on the right.

information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab.

***THERE WILL BE NO 3x3 AT THIS COMPETITION.***
Please note that this is a side events only competition and we will not be holding 3x3. Newer competitors may wish to attend another competition as their first.
